name: ICLR
summary: 投稿 9 頁、rebuttal 和 camera-ready 可到 10 頁；重大的 LLM 使用要另立章節揭露，掛名 3 篇以上的作者至少要審 6 篇。

pages.zh: 投稿時主文須在 9 頁以內。
pages.quote: At the time of submission, the main text should be 9 pages or fewer

pages.zh: 討論/rebuttal 階段與 camera-ready 的頁數上限提高到 10 頁。
pages.quote: During the discussion/rebuttal phase and for the camera ready, the page limit will be increased to 10 pages to allow for new results/discussions.

pages.zh: 參考文獻不計入頁數上限，且頁數不限。
pages.quote: The list of references does not count towards the page limit, and unlimited additional pages are allowed for the bibliography/references.

pages.zh: 選填的 ethics statement 不計入頁數上限，但不應超過 1 頁。
pages.quote: The optional ethics statement will not count toward the page limit, but should not be more than 1 page.

anonymity.zh: 主文或補充材料中洩漏作者身分的論文會被 desk reject。
anonymity.quote: Any paper where author identity is revealed in either the main text or the supplementary material will be desk rejected.

anonymity.zh: 同作者的相關 arXiv 論文不會破壞匿名；若引用應以第三人稱。
anonymity.quote: Note that related arxiv papers by the same authors do not break anonymity; if cited, these should be cited in third person.

anonymity.zh: 審稿期間可以將論文投到 arXiv 等典藏平台。
anonymity.quote: Submission of the paper to archival repositories such as arXiv is allowed during the review period.

anonymity.zh: arXiv 上有幾乎相同的版本不違反匿名政策，只要不明確提及它。
anonymity.quote: I have a nearly identical version on arxiv. Does this violate the anonymity policy? No, so long as you do not refer to it explicitly.

appendix.zh: 參考文獻後可放任意頁數的附錄，但審稿人沒有義務閱讀。
appendix.quote: Authors may use as many pages of appendices (after the bibliography) as they wish, but reviewers are not required to read the appendix.

appendix.zh: 附錄可放在主 PDF 參考文獻之後，也可作為獨立的補充材料檔案。
appendix.quote: Either is allowed: you can include the appendices at the end of the main pdf after the references, or you can include it as a separate file for the supplementary materials.

appendix.zh: 補充材料與主論文同一個截止時間。
appendix.quote: Supplementary material is due at the same time as the main paper.

appendix.zh: 審稿人被鼓勵但不被要求審閱補充材料。
appendix.quote: Note that reviewers are encouraged, but not required to review supplementary material during the review process.

llm.zh: 若 LLM 在研究構想或寫作中扮演重要角色，須另立 LLM usage 章節說明。
llm.quote: if LLMs played a significant role in research ideation and/or writing to the extent that they could be regarded as a contributor, then authors should describe the precise role of the LLM in a separate section on LLM usage.

llm.zh: LLM usage 章節可放在附錄、不計頁數；未揭露重大 LLM 使用可能遭 desk reject。
llm.quote: This section can appear in the appendix, and will not be considered as part of the page limit. Not disclosing significant LLM usage can lead to desk rejection of the paper.

llm.zh: 作者需對以其名義撰寫的內容負全責，包括 LLM 產生的內容。
llm.quote: authors should understand that they take full responsibility for the contents written under their name, including content generated by LLMs
LLMs are not eligible for authorship.

rebuttal.zh: 審稿公布後作者可在 OpenReview 回覆，並可在公開討論期結束（12/3）前修改論文。
rebuttal.quote: Once reviews have been posted, authors can post responses to the reviews as comments on OpenReview Authors can also revise their paper until the end of the public discussion period (Dec 3).

rebuttal.zh: rebuttal 修訂版的頁數上限為 10 頁。
rebuttal.quote: For rebuttal revisions, how many pages are allowed? The page limit is identical with the submission version (10 pages).

rebuttal.zh: 每則留言有字數上限，但留言數量不限。
rebuttal.quote: There is a word limit for each comment, but there is no limit on the number of comments

rebuttal.zh: AC 與審稿人可忽略與原始論文差異過大的修改。
rebuttal.quote: Area chairs and reviewers reserve the right to ignore changes that are significantly different from the original paper.

special.zh: 掛名 3 篇以上的作者須至少審 6 篇，未在 rebuttal 階段前完成者其投稿可能被 desk reject。
special.quote: All authors who are on 3 or more papers must serve as a reviewer for at least 6 papers. Authors in this category that fail to finish reviews by rebuttal stage may have their paper submissions desk rejected.

special.zh: 若投稿沒有任何作者註冊為審稿人，論文會被 desk reject。
special.quote: If none of the authors are registered as a reviewer, it will result in desk rejection for the paper.

special.zh: 投稿截止後撤稿的論文仍會公開保留在 OpenReview 的 withdrawn papers 區。
special.quote: if an author chooses to withdraw a submission, it will remain hosted by OpenReview in a publicly visible "withdrawn papers" section.

special.zh: 主文超過頁數上限的論文會被 desk reject，且嚴格執行。
special.quote: This limit will be strictly enforced. Papers with main text beyond the page limit will be desk-rejected.
